云傲手札分为上下两部，前半部分记述的是龙傲天的生平。云隐志里的龙傲天传记录的大都是龙傲天在云隐门的所作所为，其故事很有激励意义，但比较粗略。而这个手札记述的故事是很详尽的，像是他本人的回忆录，连龙傲天小时候偷黄瓜，长大后暗恋其师姐，偷偷写情书告白被拒的事都记录了。
这种流水账式的记载一个人的生平，从四五岁记事开始一直记录到五十五岁。要是换成别人，都忙着练功呢，谁有空看这种又臭又长的回忆录。但凑巧的是，陆多福正是那一个闲人，他有的是时间来看一个门派前辈的全部故事。
看得出来，这个龙傲天也是个性情中人。当其拿下门派大比头名，兴冲冲地写信告白师姐。本以为能换来师姐垂青，没想到被无情拒绝，龙傲天心灰意冷，跑去酒楼买醉一个月，把门派大比获得的奖励都当了酒钱……
后来经过其师父耐心开导，龙傲天终放下心结，从此看破红尘，一心沉溺于武道。从此龙傲天的修为扶摇直上，进入武皇境九重之后，恰逢黑虎帮作恶，毅然放弃突破的机会，仗剑除恶，自此沦为废人。
纵观龙傲天一生，有暗恋时的甜蜜，有门派大比夺魁的意气风发，有告白被拒的失落，也有看破红尘后的坦然，更有除恶务尽的义无反顾和修为尽废后的心如死灰。前辈如此丰富的人生际遇，给陆多福饱了眼福之余，也让他对人生的感悟提升了不少。但手札的下半部分，相对于陆多福来说，那就不仅仅是很大的帮助了，而是真正可以逆天改命的东西。
话说龙傲天修为尽废后，确实是郁郁寡欢，混吃等死了一段时间。失去灵脉后，他无法再修炼，也不再适合担任门派内的职务，所以他彻头彻尾成了一个闲人，比陆多福现在的情形还糟糕。
可闲了一年多后，龙傲天心血来潮，自己英雄一世，如果不留下点什么，岂不可惜了，于是他写了个回忆录，就是手札的上半部分。写完之后，龙傲天自己都感动了，如此精彩的一生，如果真混吃等死，那太窝囊了。他不甘心，想要重获修为。
可没灵脉不可修炼，这是所有武者的共识。不过凡人的共识左右不了天才的想法，龙傲天这种天才，一旦心里有了想法，哪怕再离经叛道，他都会坚持去做，不死不休。
五年后，龙傲天的坚持不懈有了回报，在经过缜密的推理和数十次的实践，他创出了一种前无古人的运气方式，叫做“无脉之息”。此法适合无脉之人的修炼，只不过缺点也很明显，由于修炼方式的不同，导致这世上所有的功法均不适合无脉者修炼，想要功法那就得自创。武技亦是如此，无脉之息的灵力运行方式跟常人不同，修炼“无脉之息”的人没办法使用常人所用的武技。
这功法的好坏，陆多福暂时也看不出来。不过凭陆多福这些年在医道上学到的经验来判断，此法没什么问题，修炼不会导致走火入魔。至于功法武技的话，因为龙傲天创出无脉之息后没多久就死了，自然也没时间来创造了。
“砰砰砰”，陆多福听着自己的心跳声，激动的手足无措。三年多了，尽管他继承了温老头的衣钵，成了云隐门的小神医，可陆多福心里清楚，他的处境并不如表面这般光鲜。
无法修炼，他陆多福永远成不了南宫修真正的弟子，也就成不了云隐门的正式弟子。偌大的云隐门，他将永远是一个外人。
而他不能修炼的事，云隐门上下无人不知。很多弟子对他是十分不屑的，认为掌门瞎了眼才要收这种人当弟子。再加上陆多福平日跟南宫月太要好，更是惹这帮年轻弟子嫉妒，所以背后都是叫他废物。只有当南宫月或者南宫修夫妇面的时候，才会违心地称他一声陆师弟。
对于乞丐出身的陆多福来说，最高的理想不过就是以后能有口饭吃。至于能不能练武，这对他而言其实不关键。只不过他实在不想因为不能修炼一事而成为别人眼中的异类，尤其是南宫修会受自己连累成为笑柄。现在这一切有改变的可能性，如何让陆多福不激动。
得告诉师父他们，让他们高兴高兴，陆多福心道。可转念一想，这八字还没一撇呢，万一自己实在没有修炼的天赋，从此止步不前，那岂不尴尬。算了，还是先不说，等真的练成了，再告诉师父他们不迟。
翌日起，陆多福开始修炼。修炼的地点，陆多福选在落霞峰的云药堂。现在温老头不在了，云药堂却依旧保留，继承了他衣钵的陆多福去那里值守，最是合适。
其实云隐门区区几百号人，又都是身强力壮的修武之人，很少有人会生病。平时那些弟子们也就相互切磋的时候有个皮外伤，自己用金疮药解决一下就好了。
至于云隐山脚下的百姓，虽说有几千人，但小镇上有医馆，基本上能满足这些百姓的需求。除了疑难杂症，很少有人会跋山涉水来云药堂求医。而且温老头去世后，部分人对于陆多福的医术还是不能完全信任，毕竟他只是个十四岁的少年。
所以云药堂现在基本只有陆多福一个人在，这极大的方便了他的修炼。进了药堂，将门一关，陆多福依照手札上的法子，盘膝坐下，引导着灵气在体内运行。

“呃……”胸口剧痛，差点让陆多福疼晕过去。但是陆多福并没有感觉意外，也没有停下的意思。根据龙傲天的注解，无脉之息的运气方法跟正常的炼气口诀是截然不同的，且更为霸道直接，所以对身体有一定的创伤。
初习者必须强忍剧痛进行炼气，强行在体内开辟一条运气的通道。随着修炼加深，痛楚会逐渐减弱。要一直练到痛感完全消失，就说明成功了，就可以正常修炼了。
这法子太过异想天开，成与不成还是未知，唯有持之以恒方能最后看结果。关键是要忍着痛楚，确是非常人能坚持下来。不过对于陆多福来说，他没得选择。
每练几日后，陆多福都要自己以银针将灵气引出，防止灵气淤积过多，伤害身体。陆多福暗自庆幸，当时温师叔祖要自己要学医，真是太有先见之明了。
练了一个月后，还是没什么效果。倒是频繁修炼，睡眠不足，精神不免变得差了，时常走神打盹，师父师娘都疑心陆多福是不是病了，要找大夫给他看。陆多福笑称自己就是大夫，赶紧找借口开溜。
直到两个月后的一个晚上，陆多福在运气的时候，隐约之中，感觉体内似有一条通道，在缓慢吸收着灵气，原本身体内的阻力骤然小了很多，痛楚也随之大减。陆多福大喜，反复运气。几天以后，运气再无阻碍，完全没了痛楚，灵气入体后转而沿着那条通道在体内运行，周身说不出的舒畅。没有了疼痛，运气后整个人也变得精神了。陆多福确定，无脉之息成了。
功夫不负有心人，陆多福狂喜之下，几乎要大声喊出来，这几个月来受的折磨有了圆满的收获。高兴过后，陆多福又冷静下来，甚至有些愁起来了。因为无脉之息是成了，可这毕竟只是个炼气之法，后续他没有功法来修炼。
没有功法，只凭炼气术，倒也不是不能修炼，只不过进度比较慢，而功法却能大大促进修炼进度。打个比方，将武皇作为一条路的终点，如果一路靠炼气上去，那跟爬着去西天取经没什么差别，而有功法的话，就相当于在走，在跑，甚至是飞，这中间的差距显而易见的。只凭炼气就想出人头地，陆多福是不信的，更不会相信什么炼气十万年，出山就无敌的鬼话。
而且功法不仅仅只是用来加速灵力修炼用的，有些可以强身健体，有些可以修炼精神力，还有某些具有特殊功能，比如青春常驻，起死回生什么的，好多功法还能当成武技来使用。可惜，陆多福现在是啥都没有。

Yun Ao's Notes is divided into two parts. The first half describes Long Aotian's life. The biography of Long Aotian in Yunyinzhi mostly records what Long Aotian did at Yunyinmen. The story is very inspiring, but relatively sketchy. The story told in this notebook is very detailed, like his own memoirs. It even records Long Aotian stealing cucumbers as a child, secretly falling in love with his senior sister when he grew up, secretly writing a love letter to confess his love and being rejected.
This kind of chronicle records a person's life, starting from the time when he was four or five years old to the age of fifty-five. If it were anyone else who would be busy practicing, who would have time to read such a stinky and long memoir. But luckily, Lu Duofu was that idler, and he had plenty of time to read the whole story of a senior in the sect.
It can be seen that this Long Aotian is also a person of temperament. When he won the first place in the sect competition, he happily wrote a letter to confess to his senior sister. He thought he could win the favor of his senior sister, but he was rejected ruthlessly. Long Aotian was so disheartened that he went to a restaurant to get drunk for a month, using all the rewards from the sect competition as drink money...
Later, after his master patiently enlightened him, Long Aotian finally let go of his worries, saw through the world of mortals, and devoted himself to martial arts. From then on, Long Aotian's cultivation skyrocketed. After entering the ninth level of the Martial Emperor Realm, the Black Tiger Gang happened to do evil. He resolutely gave up the opportunity to break through, used his sword to eliminate evil, and became a useless person ever since.
Throughout Long Aotian's life, there is the sweetness of secret love, the high-spiritedness of winning the sect competition, the disappointment of being rejected for his confession, the calmness after seeing through the world of mortals, the determination to eliminate evil without hesitation, and the despair after his cultivation has been exhausted. The rich life experiences of his predecessors not only gave Lu Duofu a feast for his eyes, but also improved his understanding of life a lot. But the second half of the handbook was not only a great help to Lu Duofu, but something that could truly change his destiny.
It is said that after Long Aotian's cultivation was completely exhausted, he was indeed depressed, eating and waiting for death for a while. After losing his spiritual vein, he could no longer practice and was no longer suitable to hold positions within the sect, so he became a complete idler, worse than Lu Duofu's current situation.
But after being idle for more than a year, Long Aotian came up with the idea that it would be a pity if he didn't leave anything behind in his heroic life, so he wrote a memoir, which is the first half of the notebook. After finishing writing, Long Aotian himself was moved. It would be too cowardly to live such a wonderful life and wait to die. He was unwilling to give in and wanted to regain his cultivation.
But it is impossible to practice without spiritual veins, this is the consensus of all warriors. However, the consensus of mortals cannot influence the ideas of geniuses. Once a genius like Long Aotian has an idea in his mind, he will insist on it and never stop working on it, no matter how deviant he is.
Five years later, Long Aotian's perseverance paid off. After careful reasoning and dozens of practices, he created an unprecedented method of luck called "Pulseless Breath." This method is suitable for the cultivation of people without pulses, but the shortcomings are also obvious. Due to the different methods of cultivation, all the exercises in this world are not suitable for the cultivation of people without pulses. If you want a method, you have to create it yourself. The same is true for martial arts. The way the spiritual power of Pulseless Breath operates is different from that of ordinary people. People who practice "Pulseless Breath" cannot use the martial arts used by ordinary people.
Lu Duofu couldn't tell whether this technique was good or bad for the time being. However, judging from Lu Duofu's experience in medicine over the years, there is nothing wrong with this method, and practice will not lead to obsession. As for martial arts and martial arts, because Long Aotian died not long after he created the pulseless breath, he naturally had no time to create it.
"Bang bang bang", Lu Duofu listened to his own heartbeat, feeling overwhelmed with excitement. It has been more than three years. Although he has inherited the mantle of Old Man Wen and has become the little miracle doctor of Yunyin Sect, Lu Duofu knows in his heart that his situation is not as glamorous as it appears.
Unable to practice, Lu DuofuHe can never become a true disciple of Nangong Xiu, and he can never become an official disciple of Yunyin Sect. In the huge Yunyin Sect, he will always be an outsider.
As for his inability to practice, no one in the Yunyin Sect knew about it. Many disciples were very disdainful of him, thinking that the master was blind to accept such a person as a disciple. In addition, Lu Duofu was always close to Nangong Yueta, which made these young disciples jealous, so they called him a waste behind his back. Only when Nangong Yue or Nangong Xiu meet their husband, will they call him Junior Brother Lu against their will.
For Lu Duofu, who was born as a beggar, his highest ideal is to have food to eat in the future. As for whether he can practice martial arts, it doesn't really matter to him. It's just that he really doesn't want to become an alien in the eyes of others because he can't practice, especially if the Nangong Xiu Society will be implicated in him and become a laughing stock. Now that there is a possibility of all this changing, how can Lu Duofu not be excited?
I have to tell Master and them to make them happy, Lu Duofu thought to himself. But then I thought about it, I haven't even finished these horoscopes yet. What if I really don't have the talent for cultivation and stop moving forward from now on, that wouldn't be embarrassing. Forget it, let's not talk about it for now. It won't be too late to tell Master and them after they have really mastered it.
From the next day, Lu Duofu began to practice. Lu Duofu chose the Yunyao Hall in Luoxia Peak as the place to practice. Now that Old Man Wen is gone, Yun Yao Tang still remains. It is most appropriate for Lu Duofu, who has inherited his mantle, to be on duty there.
In fact, there are only a few hundred people in Yunyin Sect, and they are all strong martial arts practitioners, so few of them will get sick. Normally, those disciples would just have a skin injury when they were competing with each other, and they could just treat it with the golden sore medicine.
As for the people at the foot of Yunyin Mountain, although there are thousands of them, there is a medical clinic in the town, which can basically meet the needs of these people. Except for difficult and complicated diseases, few people would travel across mountains and rivers to seek medical treatment at Yun Yaotang. Moreover, after the death of Old Man Wen, some people still did not fully trust Lu Duofu's medical skills. After all, he was only a fourteen-year-old boy.
Therefore, Lu Duofu is basically the only one in Yunyao Hall now, which greatly facilitates his practice. After entering the medicine hall and closing the door, Lu Duofu followed the instructions in the handbook, sat down cross-legged, and guided the spiritual energy to circulate in his body.
"Uh..." The pain in his chest was so severe that Lu Duofu almost fainted from the pain. But Lu Duofu didn't feel surprised and had no intention of stopping. According to Long Aotian's annotation, the luck method of Pulseless Breath is completely different from the normal Qi refining formula, and is more overbearing and direct, so it will cause certain trauma to the body.
Beginners must endure severe pain to practice Qi and forcibly open a channel for luck in the body. As practice deepens, the pain will gradually diminish. Practice until the pain completely disappears, which means you have succeeded and you can practice normally.
This method is too whimsical, and it is still unknown whether it will succeed or not. The only way to see the final result is to persevere. The key is to endure the pain, and very few people can persevere. But for Lu Duofu, he had no choice.
After every few days of practice, Lu Duofu would use silver needles to draw out the spiritual energy to prevent excessive accumulation of spiritual energy and harm to the body. Lu Duofu secretly rejoiced that Uncle Wen was so foresight when he decided to study medicine.
After practicing for a month, there is still no effect. However, he practiced frequently and lacked sleep, so his energy inevitably became poor. He often drifted off and took naps. The master and his wife both wondered if Lu Duofu was sick and wanted to see a doctor. Lu Duofu joked that he was a doctor and quickly found an excuse to escape.
Until one night two months later, when Lu Duofu was lucky, he vaguely felt that there seemed to be a channel in his body that was slowly absorbing spiritual energy. The resistance in his body suddenly became much smaller, and the pain was also greatly reduced. Lu Duofu was overjoyed and repeated his luck. A few days later, luck was no longer hindered, and the pain was completely gone. After the spiritual energy entered the body, it moved along that channel.Running in the body, the whole body feels indescribably comfortable. There is no more pain, and after luck, the whole person becomes energetic. Lu Duofu was sure that the Pulseless Breath was completed.
The hard work paid off. Lu Duofu was so happy that he almost shouted out loud. The torture he had endured in the past few months had finally paid off. After being happy, Lu Duofu calmed down again and even became a little worried. Because the pulseless breath was achieved, but after all, it was just a method of refining qi, and he had no skills to practice in the future.
Without Kung Fu and just relying on Qi Refining Technique, it is not impossible to practice, but the progress is slower, but Kung Fu can greatly promote the progress of cultivation. For example, taking Emperor Wu as the end of a road, if you rely on refining Qi all the way up, it is no different from crawling to the West to obtain scriptures. But if you have the skills, it is equivalent to walking, running, or even flying. The difference between them is obvious. Lu Duofu didn't believe that he could get ahead just by refining his qi, let alone the nonsense that after refining his qi for 100,000 years he would become invincible.
Moreover, the exercises are not only used to accelerate the cultivation of spiritual power. Some of them can strengthen the body, some can cultivate spiritual power, and some have special functions, such as permanent youth, resurrecting the dead, etc. Many of the exercises can also be used as martial arts. Unfortunately, Lu Duofu has nothing now.
